app.tagline: Your PC as a home server

install.title: Set up Konak
install.intro: Konak prepares this PC to run home server apps and makes them reachable from your phone and other devices at home. You pick the apps afterwards.
install.running: Installing… you can keep using your PC.
install.admin_note: Windows will ask once for administrator permission.

network.public_title: This network is set to Public
network.public_body: Windows blocks devices at home from reaching this PC on Public networks. Switch it to Private if this is your home network.

steps.network: Make konak.local reachable on your network

reboot.title: Restart needed
reboot.body: Windows needs a restart to finish installing WSL. Konak continues on its own after you sign in again.

done.title: Konak is ready
done.body: Konak's home page, reachable from any device on your home network:
done.tray: Konak keeps running in the system tray when you close this window.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.uac_declined: Administrator permission was declined. Konak needs it once to set up WSL and the firewall.
errors.virtualization_off: Virtualization is turned off in this PC's firmware (BIOS/UEFI). Turn it on, then try again.
errors.invalid_name: Use 1 to 63 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen.
errors.name_reserved: This name is reserved for Konak's home page.
errors.name_in_use: Another app already uses this name.
errors.name_taken_on_lan: Another device on your network already uses this name.
errors.no_lan_ip: This PC is not connected to a network.
errors.busy: This app is busy with another operation. Try again when it finishes.
errors.unknown_app: This app is not in the catalog.

home.no_apps: No apps installed yet. Install them from the Konak window on the PC.
home.cert_body: Some apps use HTTPS with Konak's own certificate. Install this certificate once on each device to trust them.

jellyfin.name: Jellyfin
jellyfin.description: Watch your movies, shows and music on any device.
